text.en:
The following essential commodities shall
not be sold at more than the maximum selling prices for
importers, wholesalers and retailers set opposite each
•FOODSTUFF (IMPORTED)
Unit Importer's
Roasted ground coffee:
Seaport Brand ...
Table Queen Brand ...... 24/1#
Baking powder:
Cresent. Brand .....

The ceiling prices hereinabove fixed Include the
7 per cent sales tax and 1 per cent municipal tax.

This Order shall take effect five days from the
date hereof.
Done in the City of Manila, this 8th day of March, in
the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty-one, and
of the Independence of the Philippines, the fifth.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Fhilippines
By the President:
TEODORO EVANGELISTA
Executive Secretary
